title: 공직자등의병역사항신고및공개에관한법률시행에관한국회규칙 / queue:ANNEX:0001:00:00001:part:1/1

ATTACHED FORM 1 ? REPORT ON MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF A CANDIDATE FOR PUBLIC OFFICE

[Candidate for Public Office]
① Name: ____________________  (Chinese characters): ____________________
② Category: ____________________
③ Prospective position: ____________________
④ Resident registration number: ____________________
⑤ Telephone number:
   Home: ____________________
   Workplace: ____________________
⑥ Address:
   Home: ____________________  Postal code (____ - ____)
   Workplace: ____________________  Postal code (____ - ____)
⑦ Place of family register: ____________________
⑧ Accompanying documents:
   □ Certificate of military service record (____ copies)
   □ Certificate of service (____ copies)

Pursuant to Article 10 (1) of the Act on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Public Servants, I hereby report the military service records as attached.

Date: ______ Year ______ Month ______ Day
Candidate for public office named above: ____________________ (signature or seal)
To the Speaker of the National Assembly

Attachment: Military Service Records of the Candidate and His or Her Lineal Descendants

Notice to candidate: Keep one copy of these reporting documents for reference when subsequently reporting changes in military service records.

[ATTACHMENT ? FRONT PAGE]
MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF CANDIDATE AND LINEAL DESCENDANTS

Fields appearing in the attachment:
① Category: ____________________
② Prospective position: ____________________
③ Name: ____________________
④ Relationship to candidate: ____________________
⑤ Name (Chinese characters): ____________________
⑥ Resident registration number: ____________________
⑦ Address: ____________________
⑨ Military service records: ____________________
⑩ Remarks: ____________________
⑧ Place of family register: ____________________

Lines for reportable persons:
- Candidate: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 1: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 2: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 3: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 4: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 5: ____________________ (signature or seal)
- Lineal descendant 6: ____________________ (signature or seal)

[ATTACHMENT ? REVERSE PAGE]
INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF THE CANDIDATE AND LINEAL DESCENDANTS

① In the "Category" field, enter "Consent to Appointment" or "Election".
② In the "Prospective Position" field, enter the position for which the candidate is proposed for consent to appointment or election.
③ In the "Name" field, write the candidate's name in Hangul.
④ In the "Relationship to Candidate" field, distinguish the candidate from his or her lineal descendants, and list the lineal descendants in birth order, including descendants who will have reached 18 years of age as of one month before the date on which the motion for consent to appointment or election is submitted. Exclude female descendants who are not liable for military service and male descendants under 18 years of age.

Instructions for entries under ④:
1. Classify persons as the candidate, son, grandson or maternal grandson.
2. For sons, specify "eldest son", "second son", "third son", etc.
3. For grandchildren, enter only "grandson" or "maternal grandson".

⑤ In the "Name" field, write the reportable person's name in Hangul and enter the Chinese characters in parentheses.
⑥ through ⑧ Omitted in the supplied Korean form.
⑨ In the "Military Service Records" field, reproduce the military service particulars exactly as shown on the certificate of military service record issued by the head of the regional military manpower office.
⑩ In the "Remarks" field:
- If the reportable person is a woman, enter "Woman".
- Where a lineal descendant of the candidate requests that the name of a disease or details of a physical or mental disability not be disclosed pursuant to Article 14 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Public Servants, enter "Request for Non-Disclosure of Disease Name (Details of Physical or Mental Disability)", and the candidate or the person concerned shall affix a seal or sign.

The readable text contains the numbered fields and six lineal-descendant signature lines shown above. The original graphic layout has not been independently inspected.
